description_en: Modifies the specifications of a service instance when the parameter values or plan settings of the service instance do not meet your requirements
description_zh: 当服务实例的参数值或套餐设置不满足您的要求时，调用UpdateServiceInstanceSpec对服务实例执行变配操作
name: UpdateServiceInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the service instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html operation to obtain the service instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/396200.html获取服务实例ID
parameters.name: service_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The plan name of the service instance.

You can specify this parameter if the service provider set Change Type to Plan Change when adding a specification modification operation.

You can obtain the plan name configured for the service by viewing the PredefinedParameters property of the DeployMetadata response parameter in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例套餐名称。

当服务商在添加变配操作时设置变更类型为套餐变更，您可以设置该参数。

您可以通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html接口中返回参数**DeployMetadata**的**PredefinedParameters**属性获取服务设置的套餐名称
parameters.name: predefined_parameters_name

parameters.help_en:
The modification parameters of the service instance.

You can specify this parameter if the service provider set Change Type to Parameter Change when adding a specification modification operation.

You can obtain the modification parameters configured for the service by viewing the ModifyParametersConfig property of the OperationMetadata response parameter in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html operation.
You can also view the modification parameters configured for the service on the Service Instance Modification page in the Compute Nest console (https://computenest.console.aliyun.com/service/instance/cn-hangzhou).

For example, if the service is configured to upgrade the ECS instance type, you must specify an instance type that is higher than the original instance type of the service instance
parameters.help_zh:
服务实例变更参数。

当服务商在添加变配操作时设置变更类型为参数变更，您可以设置该参数。

您可以通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html接口中返回参数**OperationMetadata**的**ModifyParametersConfig**属性获取服务设置的变更参数。
您还可以通过计算巢控制台 (https://computenest.console.aliyun.com/service/instance/cn-hangzhou)的服务实例变更页面查看服务设置的变更参数。

例如，如果服务设置了ECS实例规格升配，此时您需要输入比原来服务实例更高的实例规格配置
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request, including checks on permissions and instance status.

Valid values:

true: sends the request but does not create a service instance.

false: sends the request and creates the service instance if the check is passed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等操作。

取值：

true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Prometheus monitoring on the user side.

Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
用户侧是否启用Prometheus监控。

取值：

true：启用。

false：不启用
parameters.name: enable_user_prometheus

parameters.help_en:
The name of the specification modification operation.

You can obtain the name and content of the specification modification operation configured for the service by viewing the ModifyParametersConfig property of the OperationMetadata response parameter in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
变配操作名称。

您可以通过查看https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340828.html接口中返回参数**OperationMetadata**的**ModifyParametersConfig**属性获取服务设置的变配操作名称和变配操作内容
parameters.name: operation_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

Valid values:

true (default): enables automatic payment. You must ensure that your account balance is sufficient.

false: generates an order but does not deduct the fee. If the balance of your payment method is insufficient, you can set the AutoPay parameter to false. In this case, an unpaid order is generated, and you can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console (https://rdsnext.console.aliyun.com/dashboard/cn-beijing) to pay the order
fields.help_zh:
是否自动支付。

取值：

true（默认值）：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。

false：只生成订单不扣费。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录RDS管理控制台 (https://rdsnext.console.aliyun.com/dashboard/cn-beijing)自行支付
fields.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The purchase order information for Alibaba Cloud Marketplace. This parameter is not required if the service is not listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace or uses the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh: 云市场购买订单信息，服务未上云市场或按量计费不必传
parameters.name: commodity
